name: 71055 · Minden, LA
findings: ZIP 71055 (Minden) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71055 (Minden) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 71055 (Minden) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
